title: Corpus pipeline candidate record
description: One line of a stage's JSON Lines output in build/<stage>/ (03 section 6, Interchange). Every stage writes one record per unit it examined, passed or rejected, and every rejection carries a reason. Nothing is dropped silently. The envelope is shared by all stages. Stage-specific fields are allowed (additionalProperties) and are documented per kind below. Records are written with sorted keys, one per line, in a stable order, so a rerun is byte-identical.

stage.description: The stage that wrote this record.

kind.description: file: one upstream score file (stages fetch, gate). part: one melodic part of a file (read to extract). window: one proposed excerpt (windows onward).

id.description: Stable id. file: '<corpus>:<path relative to the repo root>'. part: '<file id>#<partIndex>'. window: '<part id>@<startMeasure>-<endMeasure>', with suffix '-aug2' for augmented variants.

parentId.description: Id of the record this one derives from (part to file, window to part, augmented variant to original).

reason.description: Machine-readable rejection code. Required when status is reject. Codes for the gate stage are listed in $defs.gateReason; later stages add their own, in kebab-case.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation for a rejection or a flag.

tags.description: Window tags such as grace-removed, ornament-removed, fermata-removed, final-bar-completed.

fileRecord.description: Fields of a kind=file record. Written by stage fetch (path, sha256, upstream) and extended by stage gate (licence, composer, pd). Later stages read these records to find the files that passed.

path.description: Path relative to the repository root, forward slashes.

licence.description: Gate stage only. Present on every record, so a rejected record still says what was found.

id.description: PD, CC0-1.0 or CC-BY-4.0 when recognised; the raw header text (collapsed, at most 200 characters) or null otherwise.

composer.description: Gate stage only. Who the piece is by, and where the death year came from.

pd.description: Gate stage only. The public-domain decision. basis says which clause of 03 section 6.2 step 2 decided it.

cutoff.description: composer_died_before, or edition_year_max for the edition-year basis.

meta.description: Gate stage only. Header facts later stages need for attribution (03 section 6.11). Keys are free-form strings.
